verdict.rationale: Figma docs confirm a built-in 'Figma agent' that can generate new design directions, edit images, create diagrams, and search files, plus purchasable AI credits for team use (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-24, figma-docs-29, figma-docs-34), showing genuine in-editor generative AI. However, the story's specific asset chores—background removal, content-aware fill, and copy/text suggestions—are never explicitly documented, and community feedback flags Figma's AI tools (in FigJam) as 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), tempering confidence in polish/reliability. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of background removal, content-aware fill, and copy-suggestion features, plus independent hands-on validation of quality for core Figma (not just FigJam) AI tools.
